spans.s: स्तैन, अम्, n. theft, robbery, thievery.

स्तैन्य, अम्, n. theft, thievery, robbery; (अस्),
m. a thief.

स्तै स्तै, cl. 1. P. स्तायति, &c., to put on,
adorn (= rt. स्नै); (probably also) to steal,
do anything stealthily (Ved.).

स्तैमित्य स्तैमित्य, अम्, n. (fr. स्तिमित), fixed-
ness, rigidity, immobility, numbness.
